description: This file defines an interface for reading loan reschedule requests in the Fineract platform. It declares methods for retrieving reschedule requests by loan ID, request ID, status, as well as retrieving reschedule reasons and filtering by command.

classes.name: LoanRescheduleRequestReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface that provides methods to read and retrieve loan reschedule requests and related data.

methods.name: readLoanRescheduleRequests
methods.description: Retrieves all loan reschedule requests associated with a specific loan ID.

methods.name: readLoanRescheduleRequest
methods.description: Retrieves a single loan reschedule request identified by its unique ID.

methods.name: readLoanRescheduleRequests
methods.description: Retrieves all loan reschedule requests filtered by loan ID and status enum.

methods.name: retrieveAllRescheduleReasons
methods.description: Fetches all reschedule reasons matching the provided reason string.

methods.name: retrieveAllRescheduleRequests
methods.description: Retrieves reschedule requests filtered by command type (all, approved, pending, rejected) and optionally by loan ID.
